title: Annual level changes in Superior and Michigan-Huron had a higher correlation in 1972-2025 than in 1919-1971
abstract: We tested whether annual mean level changes in Lake Superior and Michigan-Huron had the same correlation in the first and second halves of the 1919-2025 record. Fixed v2025 monthly levels gave correlations of 0.413 in 1919-1971 and 0.690 in 1972-2025. The change was +0.277, with a conditional 95% five-year block interval of +0.083 to +0.498. Three- and ten-year blocks, ranks, day weights and removal of 2013-2014 gave positive intervals. A shorter comparison of 1950-1987 and 1988-2025 gave +0.160, with an interval of -0.069 to +0.386. Thus, the full-record result does not establish a general trend or a change date. Levels alone cannot separate shared weather, upstream flow, regulation or source changes. The package gives source paths and hashes, monthly input rows, code, draws, numerical checks and a figure.
